standard.summary: auto 优先使用启动器/预检传入的 attention 参数
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: auto prefers the attention parameters passed in by the launcher or preflight
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.auto: Follows the launcher's or preflight's attention.

advanced.principle: auto 优先使用启动器/预检传入的 attention 参数；FlexAttention 需要 CUDA 与对应 PyTorch 支持。

advanced_en.principle: auto prefers the attention parameters passed in by the launcher/preflight; FlexAttention requires CUDA and matching PyTorch support.
